description: Type the not-ready-for-backups precondition on backup create (HTTP 400 FAILED_PRECONDITION: 'Cluster ... isn't ready for backups yet. Either the cluster doesn't have an instance or the instance was created too recently'). The cluster becomes backup-ready a few minutes after its primary instance is created, so callers need a tag to retry on instead of an out-of-union BadRequest.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The cluster has no instance yet, or its instance was created too recently, to take a backup (HTTP 400 FAILED_PRECONDITION). Retrying after a few minutes succeeds.
